review:
The fifth retro Hot to Burn game: 5x3, five lines, old-school fruit symbols, with lucky sevens on top.

The one twist is the flame: when it lands on a symbol it adds 1x, and the total number of flames sets the multiplier for that win, up to 5x. No free spins – just fast spins with the odd multiplied hit. 96.51% RTP. For quick classic sessions.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
